entries.title: Gord
entries.definitive_edition: Gord on Windows PC with The Alliance DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Steam/GOG PC release with The Alliance DLC
primary.why: Gord launched on Steam, GOG, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, but the sourced post-launch The Alliance DLC was announced and released on Steam with new campaign missions, biomes, monsters, and gameplay systems. Windows PC is therefore the best archive route for both fidelity/capture and the most clearly sourced complete content path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release on Steam or GOG and install The Alliance DLC for the most complete sourced route. Use console versions only after rechecking whether the same DLC/content is available on that platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the highest capture/settings ceiling and the sourced The Alliance DLC route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity route and clearest complete-content path.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-gen console release for the base game.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced advantage over PC, and the DLC route was clearest on Steam in this pass.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-gen console release for the base game.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced advantage over PC, and the DLC route was clearest on Steam in this pass.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The base game is multiplatform, but the clearest sourced DLC/completeness route in this pass is Steam PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Alliance is DLC, not a remaster or separate game; include it for the most complete sourced route.
